papers.title: Remarkable Biosynthetic Diversity in the Bionectriaceae: Uncovering the genomic basis of antipathogen bioactivity of cacao fungal endophytes Clonostachys rosea and Waltergamsia zeylanica.
papers.translated_title: Bionectriaceae中显著的生物合成多样性：揭示可可真菌内生菌Clonostachys rosea和Waltergamsia zeylanica抗病原生物活性的基因组基础。
papers.author: Atencio, L. A.
papers.summary: Cacao (Theobroma cacao) production in tropical countries is threatened by fungal diseases caused by Moniliophthora roreri and M. perniciosa. Two cacao pod endophytes from Bionectriaceae, Clonostachys rosea TCF417 and Waltergamsia zeylanica TCF400, exhibit growth antagonism towards M. roreri; however, the genetic basis underlying the bioactivity of these strains has not been addressed. Here, we aimed to identify biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) potentially associated with the antifungal bioactivity of these two strains and performed a comparative analysis with 30 publicly available Bionectriaceae genomes using BiG-SCAPE. Whole-genome sequencing using Oxford Nanopore and Illumina technologies, resulted in assemblies of 52.9 Mb (C. rosea TCF417) and 31 Mb (W. zeylanica TCF400). Genome annotation was conducted using Funannotate, and secondary metabolite BGCs were predicted using antiSMASH. The two cacao endophytes harbored 92 BGCs (C. rosea: 67; W. zeylanica: 25), indicating remarkable biosynthetic diversity. Across all 32 genomes, 1,523 BGC-containing regions were identified, most belonging to T1PKS clusters. Network-based clustering revealed 209 gene cluster families (GCFs), of which 52 corresponded to previously characterized BGCs. Conserved BGCs for antifungal compounds, including sorbicillinoids and verticillins, were identified in cacao endophytes and across Bionectriaceae. Additionally, an antifungal assay conducted here demonstrated that verticillin D from C. rosea TCF417 exhibited growth inhibition of plant pathogens Moniliophthora roreri and Mycena citricolor. With about 75% of unassigned GCFs, our results reveal a largely untapped biosynthetic repertoire in the Bionectriaceae and identify verticillin D as a candidate contributor to the antagonism of C. rosea against plant pathogens.
papers.translated_summary: 热带国家的可可（Theobroma cacao）生产正受到由Moniliophthora roreri和M. perniciosa引起的真菌病害的威胁。来自Bionectriaceae科的两个可可果荚内生菌——Clonostachys rosea TCF417和Waltergamsia zeylanica TCF400——对M. roreri表现出生长拮抗作用；然而，这些菌株生物活性背后的遗传基础尚未得到研究。在此，我们旨在鉴定可能与这两个菌株抗真菌生物活性相关的生物合成基因簇（BGCs），并使用BiG-SCAPE与30个公开可用的Bionectriaceae基因组进行了比较分析。利用Oxford Nanopore和Illumina技术进行全基因组测序，分别获得了52.9 Mb（C. rosea TCF417）和31 Mb（W. zeylanica TCF400）的组装结果。使用Funannotate进行基因组注释，并使用antiSMASH预测次级代谢产物BGCs。这两个可可内生菌共含有92个BGCs（C. rosea：67个；W. zeylanica：25个），表明其具有显著的生物合成多样性。在全部32个基因组中，共鉴定出1,523个含BGC的区域，其中大多数属于T1PKS簇。基于网络的聚类揭示了209个基因簇家族（GCFs），其中52个对应于先前已表征的BGCs。在可可内生菌及整个Bionectriaceae科中鉴定出了抗真菌化合物的保守BGCs，包括sorbicillinoids和verticillins。此外，本文进行的抗真菌试验表明，来自C. rosea TCF417的verticillin D对植物病原菌Moniliophthora roreri和Mycena citricolor表现出生长抑制作用。由于约75%的GCFs未被指定功能，我们的结果揭示了Bionectriaceae中一个很大程度上尚未被开发的生物合成资源库，并鉴定出verticillin D是C. rosea对植物病原菌拮抗作用的候选贡献因子。

papers.title: Xist deletion in T cells protects against influenza-induced lung injury
papers.translated_title: Xist在T细胞中的缺失可防止流感诱导的肺损伤
papers.author: Valero-Pacheco, N.
papers.summary: Sex differences in antiviral immunity are well established, yet the contribution of X-Chromosome Inactivation (XCI) to T cell responses during infection is unknown. Here, we identify an unexpected role for Xist RNA in shaping T cell immunity and pulmonary injury following influenza infection. We show that the inactive X chromosome (Xi) in pulmonary CD4+ and CD8+ T cells undergoes dynamic epigenetic remodeling, with limited Xist RNA localization, differential enrichment of H3K27me3 and H2AK119Ub modifications, and activation-dependent XCI escape of immune-related genes, including Il2rg and Cxcr3. Remarkably, T cell-specific Xist deletion protects female mice from influenza-induced weight loss and pulmonary pathology despite comparable early viral burdens. Transcriptomic profiling reveals increased expression of X-linked escape genes and antiviral and interferon-responsive genes, particularly in CD8+ T cells. Furthermore, Xist-deficient CD4+ and CD8+ antigen-experienced (CD44+CD11a+) T cells exhibit increased biallelic Cxcr3 expression, elevated pulmonary Cxcr3 protein levels, and enhanced IFN-{gamma} and TNF responses following ex vivo stimulation. Together, our findings reveal a previously unrecognized role for Xist RNA in regulating female antiviral T cell responses and demonstrate that enhanced T cell effector potential can accompany reduced infection-associated pulmonary injury.
papers.translated_summary: 抗病毒免疫中的性别差异已得到充分证实，但X染色体失活（XCI）对感染期间T细胞应答的贡献尚不清楚。在此，我们发现Xist RNA在流感感染后塑造T细胞免疫和肺损伤中具有意想不到的作用。我们显示，肺CD4+和CD8+ T细胞中的失活X染色体（Xi）经历动态表观遗传重塑，表现为Xist RNA定位有限、H3K27me3和H2AK119Ub修饰的差异富集，以及免疫相关基因（包括Il2rg和Cxcr3）的激活依赖性XCI逃逸。值得注意的是，T细胞特异性Xist缺失保护雌性小鼠免受流感诱导的体重减轻和肺部病理损伤，尽管早期病毒载量相当。转录组分析揭示X连锁逃逸基因以及抗病毒和干扰素应答基因的表达增加，尤其是在CD8+ T细胞中。此外，Xist缺陷的CD4+和CD8+抗原经历（CD44+CD11a+）T细胞表现出双等位基因Cxcr3表达增加、肺部Cxcr3蛋白水平升高，以及离体刺激后IFN-{gamma}和TNF应答增强。总之，我们的发现揭示了Xist RNA在调节雌性抗病毒T细胞应答中此前未被认识的作用，并证明增强的T细胞效应潜能可伴随感染相关肺损伤的减轻。

papers.title: EPIC2: integrating single-cell chromatin accessibility with human genetics to identify trait-relevant cell types
papers.translated_title: EPIC2：将单细胞染色质可及性与人类遗传学整合以识别与性状相关的细胞类型
papers.author: Zhu, L.
papers.summary: Summary: EPIC2 is a computational and statistical framework for prioritizing trait-relevant cellular contexts by integrating genome-wide association study (GWAS) summary statistics with single-cell chromatin accessibility data. It accounts for linkage disequilibrium when testing for association between GWAS association strength and cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility at both SNP and regulatory-peak resolutions. The resulting P-values are combined using the Cauchy combination test. Availability and Implementation: The core workflow is implemented in R, with source code, vignettes, and reproducible test data freely available at https://github.com/LingxuanZ/EPIC2. Supplementary Information: Supplementary material accompanies this preprint.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要：EPIC2 是一个计算与统计框架，通过整合全基因组关联研究（GWAS）汇总统计量与单细胞染色质可及性数据，对性状相关的细胞情境进行优先级排序。它在 SNP 和调控峰两种分辨率上检验 GWAS 关联强度与细胞类型特异性染色质可及性之间的关联时，考虑了连锁不平衡。所得 P 值使用柯西组合检验进行合并。可用性与实现：核心工作流程以 R 实现，源代码、示例文档和可复现测试数据可在 https://github.com/LingxuanZ/EPIC2 免费获取。补充信息：补充材料随本预印本提供。

papers.title: Bryostatin-1 exploits a developmental signaling vulnerability in MEF2D-rearranged B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia
papers.translated_title: Bryostatin-1利用MEF2D重排的B细胞前体急性淋巴细胞白血病中的发育信号脆弱性
papers.author: Glaziou, Q.
papers.summary: MEF2D-rearranged (MEF2D-r) B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (BCP-ALL) is a rare molecular subtype associated with high-risk clinical features and frequent relapse and characterized by a distinctive pre-B-cell developmental state and dependence on pre-B-cell receptor (pre-BCR) signaling. Despite these distinctive biological features, MEF2D-r BCP-ALL lacks subtype-directed therapy. Here, we identify a pharmacologically actionable vulnerability to the diacylglycerol (DAG) mimetic bryostatin-1 (Bryo-1). Across 93 BCP-ALL cell lines, MEF2D-r models were enriched for Bryo-1 sensitivity, although responses varied within the subtype and extended to selected non-MEF2D models. Sensitive cells responded at low-nanomolar concentrations with rapid ERK activation followed by loss of pre-BCR-associated components, reduced proliferation, caspase activation and cell death. Pharmacological MEK inhibition markedly attenuated Bryo-1-induced loss of viability, supporting a functional involvement of MEK-ERK signaling. Time-resolved phosphoproteomic and proteomic analyses further revealed coordinated activation of DAG-responsive signaling and subsequent remodeling of the precursor B-cell state. Bryo-1 also altered immunotherapy-relevant surface antigens, including CD19, CD20 and CD22, as part of this broader cell-state transition. Importantly, low-nanomolar activity was reproduced ex vivo in MEF2D-r patient-derived xenograft cells. Together, these findings support pharmacological activation of a negative-selection-like developmental checkpoint as a potential therapeutic strategy in responsive MEF2D-r BCP-ALL and provide a framework for biomarker-guided functional patient selection.
papers.translated_summary: MEF2D重排（MEF2D-r）B细胞前体急性淋巴细胞白血病（BCP-ALL）是一种罕见的分子亚型，与高危临床特征和频繁复发相关，其特征是独特的前B细胞发育状态以及对前B细胞受体（pre-BCR）信号的依赖。尽管具有这些独特的生物学特征，MEF2D-r BCP-ALL仍缺乏亚型导向治疗。在此，我们鉴定出对二酰甘油（DAG）模拟物bryostatin-1（Bryo-1）的一种药理学上可干预的易感性。在93个BCP-ALL细胞系中，MEF2D-r模型富集于Bryo-1敏感性，尽管亚型内反应存在差异并延伸至部分非MEF2D模型。敏感细胞在低纳摩尔浓度下即产生反应，表现为快速ERK激活，随后pre-BCR相关组分丢失、增殖减少、caspase激活和细胞死亡。药理学MEK抑制显著减弱Bryo-1诱导的活力丧失，支持MEK-ERK信号的功能性参与。时间分辨磷酸化蛋白质组学和蛋白质组学分析进一步揭示了DAG响应性信号的协同激活以及随后前体B细胞状态的重塑。作为这一更广泛细胞状态转变的一部分，Bryo-1还改变了免疫治疗相关表面抗原，包括CD19、CD20和CD22。重要的是，低纳摩尔活性在MEF2D-r患者来源异种移植细胞的离体实验中得以重现。总之，这些发现支持将类似负选择发育检查点的药理学激活作为响应性MEF2D-r BCP-ALL的一种潜在治疗策略，并为生物标志物引导的功能性患者选择提供了框架。

papers.title: High-Resolution Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals Millimeter-Scale Malignant Territories and Immune Exclusion patterns in Human Salivary Gland Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma
papers.translated_title: 高分辨率空间转录组学揭示人涎腺腺样囊性癌中毫米级恶性区域及免疫排斥模式
papers.author: Bijukumar, G.
papers.summary: Background/Objectives: Adenoid cystic carcinoma (ACC) of the salivary gland (SGACC) is a rare malignancy with frequent late recurrence and limited response to systemic and immune therapies. Bulk and single-cell sequencing do not preserve tissue architecture, so the spatial organization of its MYB-driven myoepithelial and luminal tumor cells, stroma, and immune cells remains poorly defined. This study aimed to map the SGACC tumor microenvironment at near-cellular resolution. Methods: Visium HD based spatial transcriptomics was performed on four SGACC tissue sections from three patients with tubulo-cribriform tumor form in stage III - IV. Bins of 10 x 10 {micro}m were annotated and deconvolved with cell2location using an integrated single-cell reference of 119,189 cells from 20 donors. Pseudobulk differential expression, spatial autocorrelation, potency and spatial trajectory inference, permutation-based territory analysis, Hotspot module detection, and marker-based immune profiling were applied. Results: MYB-expressing luminal (LECs-MYB) and myoepithelial (MECs-MYB) epithelial cells occupied 55.7% of bins on average. The MECs-MYB to LECs-MYB ratio increased from the nest interior toward the tumor edge, where cancer-associated fibroblasts rose sharply. Potency and trajectory analyses placed MECs-MYB upstream of LECs-MYB. Malignant states formed territories of up to 38.0 mm2 that persisted over 1.5 mm in three sections and contained spatially restricted programs. Hypoxic stressed territories also showed mTORC1, unfolded protein response, and cell-cycle programs. T/NK, myeloid, MHC class I and II, and plasma cell signatures were 1.4- to 5.7-fold higher in stroma than in tumor nests, whereas VTCN1 (B7-H4) was the only B7 family ligand enriched within nests. Conclusions: SGACC shows an ordered arrangement of malignant lineages, millimeter-scale malignant territories, MHC class - I and II enriched stroma, and immune-excluded nests enriched for B7-H4. These features provide evidence to be validated in larger cohorts with protein-level and clinical data.
papers.translated_summary: 背景/目标：唾液腺腺样囊性癌（ACC）是一种罕见的恶性肿瘤，晚期复发频繁，对全身治疗和免疫治疗反应有限。 bulk和单细胞测序不能保留组织结构，因此其由MYB驱动的肌上皮和腔面肿瘤细胞、间质和免疫细胞的空间组织仍不明确。本研究旨在以接近细胞的分辨率绘制唾液腺腺样囊性癌（SGACC）肿瘤微环境图谱。方法：对来自3例III-IV期管状-筛状肿瘤形态患者的4份SGACC组织切片进行基于Visium HD的空间转录组学检测。对10 x 10 {micro}m的bin进行注释，并使用来自20名供者的119,189个细胞的整合单细胞参考，通过cell2location进行去卷积。应用了伪bulk差异表达、空间自相关、效力与空间轨迹推断、基于置换的区域分析、Hotspot模块检测以及基于标志物的免疫谱分析。结果：表达MYB的腔面（LECs-MYB）和肌上皮（MECs-MYB）上皮细胞平均占据55.7%的bin。从巢内部向肿瘤边缘，MECs-MYB与LECs-MYB的比值增加，在肿瘤边缘癌症相关成纤维细胞急剧上升。效力和轨迹分析将MECs-MYB置于LECs-MYB上游。恶性状态形成高达38.0 mm2的区域，在三个切片中持续超过1.5 mm，并包含空间受限的程序。缺氧应激区域还显示mTORC1、未折叠蛋白反应和细胞周期程序。T/NK、髓系、MHC I类和II类以及浆细胞特征在间质中比在肿瘤巢中高1.4至5.7倍，而VTCN1（B7-H4）是巢内唯一富集的B7家族配体。结论：SGACC显示恶性谱系的有序排列、毫米级恶性区域、MHC I类和II类富集的间质，以及富含B7-H4的免疫排斥巢。这些特征提供了可在更大队列中通过蛋白水平和临床数据加以验证的证据。

papers.title: High GPX4 Expression Marks an Oxidative-Metabolic, PD-L1/CD47-Low and Stroma-Poor Tumor State in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
papers.translated_title: 高GPX4表达标志肝细胞癌中一种氧化代谢型、PD-L1/CD47低表达且间质贫乏的肿瘤状态
papers.author: Govindaraj, P. R.
papers.summary: Background: Glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) protects cancer cells from ferroptosis and is a candidate therapeutic target in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). How GPX4 expression relates to the immune and metabolic features of patient tumors is not well characterized. Methods: We analyzed RNA-sequencing data from 366 primary tumors of the TCGA-LIHC PanCancer Atlas cohort (365 with survival data). Associations between GPX4 and ten immune and stress-response markers were tested by Spearman correlation with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, then re-estimated after adjustment for consensus tumor purity, CTNNB1 and TP53 mutation, age and sex. A T-cell-inflamed profile, a CD8 T-cell score and an NRF2 target-gene score, gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) of GPX4-high versus GPX4-low tumors, and Cox models were added as further tests. Results: Higher GPX4 expression was associated with lower expression of PD-L1 (CD274; rho = -0.34, 95% CI -0.43 to -0.24, p = 2.4 x 10^-11), CD47 (rho = -0.21), the macrophage marker CD163 (rho = -0.17) and a fibroblast/extracellular-matrix score (rho = -0.22). These associations persisted after adjustment (CD274 rho = -0.37 in the fully adjusted model). GSEA showed enrichment of oxidative phosphorylation, mitochondrial, fatty-acid, xenobiotic and glutathione metabolism programs and depletion of extracellular-matrix, TGF-beta and cell-adhesion programs in GPX4-high tumors. GPX4 was not associated with a T-cell-inflamed profile (rho = -0.07), a CD8 T-cell score (rho = -0.03), cytolytic activity (rho = 0.04) or an NRF2 target-gene score (rho = 0.03), although NFE2L2 mRNA was inversely correlated with GPX4 (rho = -0.32). GPX4 expression was not associated with overall survival (stage-adjusted hazard ratio per SD 1.09, 95% CI 0.91-1.29). Conclusions: In TCGA-LIHC, high GPX4 expression marks a metabolically active, PD-L1/CD47-low and matrix-poor tumor state, with no evidence of T-cell exclusion, NRF2 pathway activation or prognostic value. These correlative findings come from a single cohort and require external validation and functional testing. Keywords: hepatocellular carcinoma; ferroptosis; GPX4; PD-L1; CD47; tumor microenvironment; NRF2; gene set enrichment analysis; TCGA
papers.translated_summary: 背景：谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）保护癌细胞免受铁死亡，是肝细胞癌（HCC）的候选治疗靶点。GPX4表达与患者肿瘤免疫和代谢特征的关系尚不明确。方法：我们分析了TCGA-LIHC PanCancer Atlas队列中366例原发肿瘤的RNA测序数据（365例有生存数据）。通过Spearman相关分析及Benjamini-Hochberg校正检验GPX4与十种免疫和应激反应标志物的关联，随后在调整共识肿瘤纯度、CTNNB1和TP53突变、年龄和性别后重新评估。进一步采用T细胞炎症特征、CD8 T细胞评分和NRF2靶基因评分、GPX4高表达与低表达肿瘤的基因集富集分析（GSEA）以及Cox模型作为补充检验。结果：GPX4表达较高与PD-L1（CD274；rho = -0.34，95% CI -0.43至-0.24，p = 2.4 x 10^-11）、CD47（rho = -0.21）、巨噬细胞标志物CD163（rho = -0.17）和成纤维细胞/细胞外基质评分（rho = -0.22）表达较低相关。这些关联在调整后持续存在（完全调整模型中CD274 rho = -0.37）。GSEA显示GPX4高表达肿瘤中氧化磷酸化、线粒体、脂肪酸、外源物质和谷胱甘肽代谢程序富集，而细胞外基质、TGF-beta和细胞黏附程序耗竭。GPX4与T细胞炎症特征（rho = -0.07）、CD8 T细胞评分（rho = -0.03）、细胞溶解活性（rho = 0.04）或NRF2靶基因评分（rho = 0.03）无关，尽管NFE2L2 mRNA与GPX4呈负相关（rho = -0.32）。GPX4表达与总生存期无关（分期调整后每SD风险比1.09，95% CI 0.91-1.29）。结论：在TCGA-LIHC中，GPX4高表达标志着代谢活跃、PD-L1/CD47低表达和基质贫乏的肿瘤状态，无证据表明存在T细胞排斥、NRF2通路激活或预后价值。这些相关性发现来自单一队列，需要外部验证和功能测试。关键词：肝细胞癌；铁死亡；GPX4；PD-L1；CD47；肿瘤微环境；NRF2；基因集富集分析；TCGA

papers.title: Syngeneic human iPSC Macrophages and Microglia possess distinct neuroinflammatory profiles, responses to HIV infection, and ART treatment
papers.translated_title: 同源人类iPSC巨噬细胞和小胶质细胞具有不同的神经炎症特征、对HIV感染的反应以及ART治疗反应
papers.author: Oteju, O.
papers.summary: Macrophages are innate immune cells that primarily function as professional phagocytes, playing essential roles throughout the body in host defense and maintaining homeostasis. The CNS is populated by two anatomically distinct macrophage populations; parenchymal microglia and border-resident CNS-associated macrophages (CAMs). These populations coordinate the neuroinflammatory response to pathogen-associated molecular patterns (PAMPs) through Toll-like receptor (TLR) signaling and are exposed to distinct microenvironmental cues that could shape their functions. CNS macrophages are also involved in infection with neurotropic viruses such as HIV, where the persistent infection contributes to chronic neuroinflammation and the constellation of other neurological symptoms collectively termed neuroHIV. Although antiretroviral therapy (cART) has transformed HIV care and lessened the severity of many neuroHIV symptoms, the persistence of CNS viral reservoirs and neurological deficits remains a major comorbidity and barrier to cure. Understanding specific contributions of microglia and CAMs to inflammation and neuroHIV has been challenging due to the lack of genetically matched human model systems enabling direct mechanistic comparison between of microglia and CAMs. To address this, we optimized the generation of syngeneic, human-induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) derived microglia-like (iMg) and CAM-like (iMacs) cells. These are generated simultaneously from a single donor line and have the same genetic background, enabling side-by-side characterization and functional analyses of inflammation and HIV infection. Transcriptomic profiling by RNA sequencing revealed substantial baseline differences in inflammatory and immune signaling pathways between iMg and iMacs. These intrinsic differences were also observed in TLR-specific NF-{kappa}B responses. Stimulation of TLR4 drove heightened response in iMg relative to iMac, correlating closely with morphological changes, while stimulating TLR2 had a contrasting effect, eliciting a stronger and more robust early NF-{kappa}B response in iMacs. In HIV infection studies, iMacs were more permissive to viral replication at baseline, whereas iMg showed a reduced susceptibility to infection. However, iMacs responded more robustly to cART, while iMg exhibited relative resistance to cART-mediated suppression. These findings delineate fundamental inflammatory and virologic differences between human microglia and CAMs and provide a robust foundation on which to further examine HIV infection, cART efficacy, and immune function in these distinct CNS myeloid populations.
papers.translated_summary: 巨噬细胞是固有免疫细胞，主要作为专职吞噬细胞发挥作用，在全身宿主防御和维持稳态中扮演重要角色。中枢神经系统（CNS）中存在两个解剖学上不同的巨噬细胞群体：实质小胶质细胞和边界驻留的CNS相关巨噬细胞（CAMs）。这些群体通过Toll样受体（TLR）信号协调对病原体相关分子模式（PAMPs）的神经炎症反应，并暴露于可能塑造其功能的不同微环境线索中。CNS巨噬细胞还参与嗜神经病毒如HIV的感染，其中持续性感染导致慢性神经炎症和其他一系列统称为神经HIV的神经系统症状。尽管抗逆转录病毒治疗（cART）已改变了HIV护理并减轻了许多神经HIV症状的严重程度，但CNS病毒储存库的持续存在和神经功能缺损仍然是主要的共病和治愈障碍。由于缺乏能够直接进行小胶质细胞和CAMs之间机制比较的遗传匹配人类模型系统，理解小胶质细胞和CAMs对炎症和神经HIV的具体贡献一直具有挑战性。为解决这一问题，我们优化了同基因型、人诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源的小胶质细胞样（iMg）和CAM样（iMacs）细胞的生成。这些细胞同时从单一供体细胞系生成，具有相同的遗传背景，使得能够并排进行炎症和HIV感染的表征及功能分析。通过RNA测序进行的转录组分析揭示了iMg和iMacs在炎症和免疫信号通路方面存在显著基线差异。这些内在差异也在TLR特异性NF-{kappa}B反应中观察到。TLR4刺激在iMg中引起比iMac更强的反应，与形态学变化密切相关，而刺激TLR2则产生相反效果，在iMacs中引发更强、更稳健的早期NF-{kappa}B反应。在HIV感染研究中，iMacs在基线时对病毒复制更为允许，而iMg显示出较低的感染易感性。然而，iMacs对cART反应更为强烈，而iMg表现出对cART介导抑制的相对抵抗。这些发现描绘了人类小胶质细胞和CAMs之间基本的炎症和病毒学差异，为进一步研究这些不同CNS髓系群体中的HIV感染、cART疗效和免疫功能提供了坚实基础。

papers.title: Media matters: A resource for understanding the determinants of migratory potential of malignant and non-malignant cells
papers.translated_title: 媒体至关重要：理解恶性和非恶性细胞迁移潜能决定因素的一种资源
papers.author: Kim, B.
papers.summary: Cell mobility is critical for homeostatic processes such as wound repair and diseases like cancer metastasis. While the advent of migrastatic and antimetastatic therapies has promise, the identification and translation of pathways important for migratory plasticity into druggable targets approved in clinical trials are considerably lacking. To better understand why, we developed an unbiased high-throughput wound-healing/invasion assay to screen for the migratory potential of >60 non-malignant and malignant cell lines derived from the pancreas, colon, skin, breast, prostate, and lung. The goal of this phenotypic screen was to provide a resource of migration/invasion potential and insight into the differential properties not only between malignant and non-malignant cells but also the various carcinomas. Surprisingly, we found non-malignant epithelial cells of the lung, skin, and pancreas migrated/invaded faster than their malignant counterparts. We observed perturbation of glucose metabolism, via inhibition of glycolysis, restricted the migration of non-malignant but not cancer cells, whereas inhibition of oxidative phosphorylation limited the mobility of malignant more than normal cells of the lung, skin, and pancreas. Short-term acclimation of cancer cells in low-nutrient media, containing low/no serum, low calcium, and physiological concentrations of glucose, increased in vitro migration/invasion and in vivo metastatic potential of lung but not pancreatic carcinomas. Phenotypic and metabolic screens presented here could identify prospective therapeutics not only for cancer metastasis, but also diseases driven by the dysregulation of wound-healing/regeneration.
papers.translated_summary: 细胞运动性对于伤口修复等稳态过程以及癌症转移等疾病至关重要。尽管迁移抑制和抗转移疗法的出现带来了希望，但将参与迁移可塑性的重要通路识别并转化为经临床试验批准的可用药靶点方面仍存在显著不足。为更好地理解其原因，我们开发了一种无偏倚的高通量伤口愈合/侵袭实验，用于筛选源自胰腺、结肠、皮肤、乳腺、前列腺和肺的60余种非恶性和恶性细胞系的迁移潜能。该表型筛选的目标是提供一份迁移/侵袭潜能的资源，并深入揭示不仅恶性与非恶性细胞之间、而且各种癌之间的差异特性。令人惊讶的是，我们发现肺、皮肤和胰腺的非恶性上皮细胞比其恶性对应细胞迁移/侵袭得更快。我们观察到，通过抑制糖酵解来扰动葡萄糖代谢，限制了非恶性细胞而非癌细胞的迁移；而抑制氧化磷酸化对肺、皮肤和胰腺恶性细胞运动性的限制大于正常细胞。癌细胞在低营养培养基（含低/无血清、低钙和生理浓度葡萄糖）中的短期适应，增加了肺腺癌而非胰腺癌的体外迁移/侵袭和体内转移潜能。本文所呈现的表型和代谢筛选不仅可为癌症转移，还可为伤口愈合/再生失调驱动的疾病识别前瞻性治疗药物。

papers.title: YAP activity sustains mitochondrial adaptation to NAMPT inhibition in triple-negative breast cancer
papers.translated_title: YAP活性维持三阴性乳腺癌中对NAMPT抑制的线粒体适应
papers.author: Buongiorno, A.
papers.summary: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) is an essential metabolic cofactor, and maintenance of NAD+ homeostasis is critical for cancer cell survival. Pharmacological inhibition of nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase (NAMPT), the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway, induces NAD+ depletion and energetic stress, although the development of resistance limits its therapeutic potential. We have previously shown that acquired resistance to NAMPT inhibition in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) cells is associated with extensive metabolic rewiring. Here, we investigated the role of the Hippo pathway effector YAP in the cellular adaptation to NAMPT inhibition. Stable YAP downregulation markedly decreased the sensitivity of MDA-MB-231 cells to the NAMPT inhibitors FK866 and CHS-828, whereas re-expression of constitutively active YAP5SA partially restored sensitivity to FK866. YAP-silenced cells maintained NAD(H) and ATP levels during FK866 exposure and showed reduced oxidative stress and caspase 3/7 activation. Comparative proteomic analysis of YAP-silenced cells and cells with acquired FK866 resistance revealed common alterations in mitochondrial, cell-cycle, and RNA-processing programs. Consistently, YAP downregulation altered the cell-cycle response to FK866 and increased mitochondrial respiration, spare respiratory capacity, and mitochondrial mass. These findings identify YAP as a modulator of the cellular response to NAMPT inhibition and suggest that sustained YAP downregulation contributes to the establishment of an adaptive state characterized by reduced proliferative and biosynthetic programs together with increased mitochondrial capacity.
papers.translated_summary: 烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD+）是一种必需的代谢辅因子，维持NAD+稳态对癌细胞存活至关重要。药理学抑制烟酰胺磷酸核糖转移酶（NAMPT）——NAD+补救途径的限速酶——会诱导NAD+耗竭和能量应激，尽管耐药性的产生限制了其治疗潜力。我们此前已表明，三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）细胞对NAMPT抑制获得性耐药与广泛的代谢重编程相关。在此，我们研究了Hippo通路效应分子YAP在细胞适应NAMPT抑制中的作用。稳定下调YAP显著降低了MDA-MB-231细胞对NAMPT抑制剂FK866和CHS-828的敏感性，而重新表达组成性活跃的YAP5SA部分恢复了对FK866的敏感性。YAP沉默细胞在FK866暴露期间维持了NAD(H)和ATP水平，并表现出氧化应激和caspase 3/7活化减少。对YAP沉默细胞和获得性FK866耐药细胞的比较蛋白质组学分析揭示了线粒体、细胞周期和RNA加工程序的共同改变。一致地，YAP下调改变了对FK866的细胞周期反应，并增加了线粒体呼吸、备用呼吸能力和线粒体质量。这些发现表明YAP是细胞对NAMPT抑制反应的调节因子，并提示持续的YAP下调有助于建立一种适应性状态，其特征是增殖和生物合成程序减少以及线粒体能力增加。

papers.title: Metabolic priming recruits tumour cells across a mitochondrial vulnerability threshold and sensitizes them to chemotherapy
papers.translated_title: 代谢启动使肿瘤细胞跨越线粒体脆弱性阈值并使其对化疗敏感
papers.author: Iborra, F. J.
papers.summary: Intratumour heterogeneity allows a fraction of cancer cells to escape otherwise effective treatment. Here we ask whether metabolic priming can recruit heterogeneous tumour cells into a transient mitochondrial state that is selectively vulnerable to photodynamic damage. Tetramethylrhodamine methyl ester (TMRM) has previously been shown to act as a mitochondria targeted photosensitizer; we exploit its voltage-dependent accumulation and dynamic fluorescence during pulsed illumination to quantify vulnerability in single cells. The response is a reproducible fluorescence excursion, a rise to a maximum followed by a decay, accompanied by reactive oxygen species production. Comparing seventeen descriptors of this excursion against subsequent fate in 195 cells across four arms shows that quantities referenced to each cell's own resting value outperform static intensity. The simple difference Fmax F0 predicts death with held-out areas under the curve of approximately 0.75 to 0.79, whereas resting intensity alone carries little transferable information and time to peak does not discriminate fate in the datasets tested. Metabolic priming with the PKM2 activator TEPP46 or with ethyl pyruvate increases the fraction of responding cells; under TEPP46 almost the whole population enters the responding state. PKM2 abundance is associated with faster entry into that state, and PKM2 is heterogeneous in human skin tumour sections. Four hours of camptothecin shifts the response distribution, increasing the fraction of cells above the untreated median from 50% to 76%, identifying a candidate intervention window. In combination experiments, TMRM photodynamic treatment produced survival below the Bliss-independence expectation with camptothecin or TRAIL, in both treatment orders and across three cell lines; these combination measurements are descriptive and require independent replication. The study therefore identifies a perturbation-revealed mitochondrial vulnerability that can be pharmacologically recruited and followed dynamically at single-cell resolution. It is a proof of concept in cultured cells and human tumour sections and has not been tested in vivo.
papers.translated_summary: 肿瘤内异质性使一部分癌细胞能够逃避原本有效的治疗。在此，我们探讨代谢预激是否能够将异质性肿瘤细胞招募进入一种短暂的线粒体状态，该状态对光动力损伤具有选择性脆弱性。四甲基罗丹明甲酯（TMRM）此前已被证明可作为线粒体靶向光敏剂；我们利用其在脉冲光照下依赖电压的积累和动态荧光来量化单细胞的脆弱性。其响应是一种可重复的荧光偏移，即上升至最大值后衰减，并伴随活性氧的产生。将这一偏移的十七项描述指标与195个细胞在四个实验组中的后续命运进行比较，结果表明以每个细胞自身静息值为参照的量优于静态强度。简单的差值Fmax−F0预测死亡的留出曲线下面积约为0.75至0.79，而仅静息强度几乎不携带可迁移的信息，达峰时间在测试的数据集中不能区分命运。用PKM2激活剂TEPP46或丙酮酸乙酯进行代谢预激可增加响应细胞的比例；在TEPP46作用下，几乎整个细胞群体都进入响应状态。PKM2丰度与更快进入该状态相关，且PKM2在人皮肤肿瘤切片中具有异质性。四小时喜树碱处理改变了响应分布，使高于未处理中位数的细胞比例从50%增加到76%，确定了一个候选干预窗口。在联合实验中，TMRM光动力处理与喜树碱或TRAIL联合时产生的存活率低于Bliss独立模型的预期，在两种处理顺序和三种细胞系中均如此；这些联合测量为描述性结果，需要独立重复验证。因此，本研究识别出一种由扰动揭示的线粒体脆弱性，可通过药理学手段加以招募，并能在单细胞分辨率下动态追踪。这是在培养细胞和人肿瘤切片中的概念验证，尚未在体内进行测试。
